caption: The drawing features a single object, a stylized horse figure depicted in mid-gallop, facing to the right. The horse is rendered in shades of brown with subtle shading to suggest volume and musculature. The mane and tail are both textured with fine lines to imply hair. Each of the four legs is extended outward, with the front left and back right legs reaching forward, and the front right and back left legs stretching backward, indicating motion. The hooves are colored a grayish blue, and the areas just above the hooves are a lighter, almost cream color. The horse’s joints are depicted with simple lines and subtle curves. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present in the composition.
title: Wooden Horse Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
